prompt.en: For how many different integer inputs between 0 and 100 (inclusive) does this program output Cool?

    a -= 1

prompt.en:
The Byteland Meteorological Agency is upgrading their weather stations to be automated. One of the goals is to calculate the Maximum Sustained Wind over a period of data gathering. A Sustained Wind is the average value of a continuous window of len data points.

data_points stores the values of N data points gathered. It is guaranteed that 1 ≤len ≤N ≤10000 and 1 ≤data_points[i] ≤100.

Assuming MaxSum is correctly implemented, complete the function MaxSustainedWind such that it returns the maximum sustained wind in a floating point value.

targets.helperSource: int MaxSum(vector<int> &data_points, int len) { int best = -1; for (int i = 0; i + len <= data_points.size(); ++i) { int sum = 0; for (int j = i; j < i + len; ++j) sum += data_points[j]; best = max(best, sum); } return best; }
